entities.summary: Alan Permane is a British Formula One engineer. He is the current Team Principal for Racing Bulls since 2025. Previously, he served as the Sporting Director, Chief Operating Officer, Chief Race Engineer for the Alpine F1 Team/Renault F1 Team and Racing Director for Racing Bulls.
